vuln.name: Chinese Resident ID Card Number Disclosed
vuln.description: A response body contains what matches the format of a Chinese resident identity card number (18 digits, valid region/date/checksum).
vuln.impact: Disclosure of resident ID numbers is a privacy breach subject to China's Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL) and may enable identity fraud.
vuln.recommendation: Remove the ID numbers from the response. Avoid storing or transmitting resident IDs in plaintext; mask or tokenize them and restrict access.
